name: Milipertine
summary: Milipertine is a drug of the pertine group described as an antipsychotic, neuroleptic, and tranquilizer which was under development for the treatment of schizophrenia but was never marketed.

pharmacology.text: The related drug oxypertine shows high affinity for the serotonin 5-HT2 and dopamine D2 receptors (Ki = 8.6 nM and 30 nM, respectively) and is also known to act as a catecholamine depleting agent.

uses.text: Milipertine (INN, USAN; developmental code name WIN-18935) is a drug of the pertine group described as an antipsychotic, neuroleptic, and tranquilizer which was under development for the treatment of schizophrenia but was never marketed.

sideEffects.text: The side effects of milipertine occurred too frequently and at doses well below those producing antipsychotic effects and its development was abandoned.
